note: Private 21-acre glampground and RV park at the Southwind Rail Trail trailhead in Humboldt; nine RV sites in the paved main lot beside cabins and mini A-frames, a 3-acre quarry pond for fishing and paddling (kayaks and bikes free to guests), bike skills course. Shower house is a fair walk from the RV lot. No tent camping. --Claude
summary: Operator + its Hipcamp RV listing: 9 full-hookup 30/50-amp pull-throughs in the paved lot, 45-ft max, $35/night base on Hipcamp (1-night minimum), showers. Google 4.9/50, phone (620) 234-0567. Added count, max rig, showers, booking, fees. Pond is 3 acres: not waterfront kept. Pin ~400 m off.
flags: PRICE GATE: $35 Hipcamp base (read 2026-11-05, no dates selected; Hipcamp adds a guest fee) - under US$50. Gateway check not needed.

PRESENCE: working operator site + Hipcamp booking + Google 4.9 from 50 reviews with phone (620) 234-0567. The operator site shows no phone; Google's number is the only one found. RV Life 5 stars (4 reviews), Hipcamp 4.95 from 132.
LONG-STAY TESTS: all pass - a nightly glampground selling 1-night stays online; nothing seasonal or residential.

WEBSITE: line 1 https://www.basecamp-humboldt.com/ is live. Line 2 https://basecamphumboldt.lodgify.com/en/cabins books the cabins only; the RV sites book on https://www.hipcamp.com/en-US/land/kansas-basecamp-humboldt-qeoh9m7y (the operator's own RV link, a claimed listing). Suggest replacing the Lodgify line with the Hipcamp URL.
PIN MOVE: stored 37.8210,-95.4316 is on the cement plant's grounds west of the rail line; the RV lot (paved, RVs parked) is at ~37.8210,-95.4270, ~400 m east (Google's pin 37.8204,-95.4267 agrees).

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: the operator calls it a '3-acre quarry pond' (imagery agrees); under 5 acres is a pond, and it sits ~100 m from the lot behind trees. The Neosho River is not near the sites. SAND: none.
Hipcamp lists 7 RV sites against the operator's nine; count 9 written from the operator.
